verdicts.decision_note: The client defines the bottle, slogan wording, placement, and cloud-shaped typography for the rendered illustration artifact.

The client changes the illustration's typography to the referenced Cloud Sketch font and a two-line straight arrangement; removing the prior text_shape key prevents the obsolete cloud-shaped arrangement from conflicting with the replacement.
The client explicitly specifies the exact slogan text and capitalization to be rendered in the illustration.
The client adds a concrete text-rendering constraint that Creativity must appear as one uninterrupted word in the illustration.
First concrete client verification of the revised bottle-and-slogan illustration after the font, layout, wording, and word-rendering changes.
